blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Agent learning is shifting from learning from human data toward learning through interaction with the world. However, scaling such learning directly in real-world computer systems is challenging and can introduce substantial security risks. We therefore propose Agent World Model in the Wild (WildAWM), a scalable pipeline for synthesizing controllable environments and tasks for training general computer-use agents (CUAs). Whereas existing approaches typically specialize in a single agent interaction interface, we construct executable environments that jointly support graphical user interfaces, model context protocol services, and command-line interfaces, allowing agents to flexibly combine visual interaction, tool use, and code execution. WildAWM is entirely powered by open-source models, demonstrating that high-quality computer-use environments can be generated without proprietary frontier models. Beyond environments, we address three recurring challenges in task synthesis: ensuring solvability, maintaining sufficient difficulty, and producing reliable verifiers, by introducing execution-based quality gates that combine heterogeneous agent rollouts, cross-judge consistency checks, and counterfactual probes of judgment robustness. The resulting pipeline synthesizes 341 long-horizon environment-task pairs that can require over 100 agent steps to solve and remain challenging even for frontier models, with GPT-6-Astra solving only 60% of them. We train two Qwen models of different sizes exclusively in these synthetic worlds. Both models achieve substantial gains across 8 out-of-distribution benchmarks spanning web, claw, and computer-use agents, demonstrating that learning in WildAWM's synthesized worlds generalizes broadly to unseen computer-use tasks. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/WildAWM.
blocks.zh: 代理学习正在从学习人类数据转向通过与世界的互动来学习。 然而,在现实世界计算机系统中直接推广这种学习具有挑战性,可能带来巨大的安全风险。 因此,我们提议在野外建立世界代理模式(WildAWM),这是一个可扩展的管道,用于合成可控制的环境和培训一般计算机使用代理的任务。 虽然现有方法一般专门用于单一代理交互界面,但我们构建可执行环境,共同支持图形用户界面,模式上下文协议服务,以及命令行界面,使代理能够灵活地将视觉交互,工具使用和代码执行结合起来. WildAWM完全由开源模型提供动力,表明高质量的计算机使用环境可以在没有专有前沿模型的情况下生成. 除了环境之外,我们还应对任务综合中反复出现的三个挑战:确保可溶性、保持足够的困难并产生可靠的核实者,方法是采用基于执行的质量门,将不同代理人的推出、交叉判断的一致性检查和判断力的反事实探测结合起来。 由此形成的管线合成了341个长相环境任务对子,可以要求100多个代理步骤来解决并保持挑战,即使是前沿模型,GPT-6-Astra只解决了其中60%. 我们专门在这些合成世界训练两个大小不同的Quen模型. 这两个模型在覆盖网络、爪子和计算机使用物剂的8项分配外基准上都取得了巨大收益,表明在WINDAWM的合成世界中学习可以将计算机使用任务广泛归纳为看不见的任务。 该守则可在https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/WildAWM上公开查阅。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Large language model (LLM) powered agents are shifting from learning from humans to learning from the world ( Silver & Sutton, 2025 ) . Early agents learned from human data, which are expensive to collect and limited by demonstrator’s ability. Recent agents instead gain much of their capability through reinforcement learning (RL) in executable environments ( Team et al., 2026 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) , making environment supply a key bottleneck.
However, training directly in the real world is costly and risky: states are hard to reset, online services change over time, and exploratory actions may have unintended consequences. 1 1 1 For example, see OpenAI’s recent incident report on real-world RL at this url . Manually built environments restore control and verifiability ( Yao et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2024 ) , but remain expensive and hard to scale.
Synthetic environments and tasks offer a path to controllable, large-scale online RL.
blocks.zh:
大型语言模型(LLM)的动力剂正在从从人类学习转向世界学习(Silver & Sutton, 2025). 早期的物剂从人类数据中吸取了教训,这些数据的收集费用高昂,并且受到演示人能力的限制. 近期的代理商反而通过在可执行环境中的强化学习(RL)获得了很大的能力(Team等人,2026年;Zeng等人,2026年;Xu等人,2026年),使得环境供应成为关键的瓶颈.
然而,直接在现实世界中进行培训成本高昂,风险很大:国家很难重设,在线服务随时间而变化,探索行动可能会产生意想不到的后果. 例如OpenAI最近关于现实世界的RL事件报告, 人工建设的环境恢复控制和可核查性(姚等人,2024年;周等人,2024年;谢等人,2024年),但仍很昂贵,难以推广.
合成环境和任务提供了可控,大规模在线RL的路径.

blocks.en:
Computer-Use Agents (CUAs) represent a broad setting for environment synthesis, as they operate across applications, websites, and local files on a personal computer.
A single task may be completed through graphical user interface (GUI) interaction, command-line interface (CLI) operations, or calls to model context protocol (MCP) servers, making interface selection and coordination an important capability.
Existing synthesis pipelines often target individual interaction modes, including browser use ( Zhou, 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) , tool calling ( Du et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026d ) , and terminal workflows ( Li et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) .
Prior CUA work, however, often focuses primarily on GUI interaction ( Aggarwal et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) .
In this paper, we adopt a broader view of computer use spanning common interfaces on a personal computer, since real computer-use tasks are defined by what can be accomplished rather than by a single interaction modality.
blocks.zh:
计算机使用代理(CUAs)代表了环境合成的广泛环境,因为它们在个人计算机上的应用程序、网站和当地文件之间运作。
单项任务可以通过图形用户界面(GUI)交互,命令行界面(CLI)操作完成,或调用上下文协议(MCP)服务器模型,使界面选择和协调成为一个重要的能力.
现有合成管道经常针对个人交互模式,包括浏览器使用(周,2026;吴等人,2026),工具调用(杜等人,2026;王等人,2026d),终端工作流程(李等人,2026;朱等人,2026).
然而,之前的CUA工作往往主要侧重于GUI的互动(Aggarwal等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年a ).
在本文中,我们从更广的角度看待计算机的使用,跨越个人计算机上的共同接口,因为真正的计算机使用任务是由可以实现的而不是单一的交互模式来定义的.

blocks.en:
Synthesizing environments and tasks for this broader CUA setting introduces challenges beyond prior synthesis work. Existing approaches often synthesize visually simplified applications and build each application as an isolated environment.
In contrast, realistic computer use spans a connected digital workspace in which websites, applications, MCP services, and local files coexist within an executable personal computer environment.
Meanwhile, synthesized tasks should be solvable under the synthesized environment state, sufficiently challenging to provide useful learning signals, and paired with reliable verifiers to distinguish successful completion from incorrect outcomes, all without relying on simplistic assumptions such as “a frontier model is necessarily correct.”
blocks.zh:
综合环境和任务,为这种更广泛的《海关统一分类法》设定,提出了超出先前综合工作的挑战。 现有方法常常综合视觉简化应用,将每个应用建设成孤立的环境.
相比之下,现实的计算机使用跨越一个连接的数字工作空间,其中网站,应用程序,MCP服务,以及本地文件在可执行的个人计算机环境中共存.
同时,综合任务应在综合环境状态下可溶解,具有足够的挑战性,能够提供有用的学习信号,并配以可靠的核查器,以区分成功完成和不正确的结果,所有这些都不依赖于诸如“前沿模式必然是正确的”等简单假设。 “

blocks.en:
To address these challenges, we propose WildAWM , a scalable synthesis pipeline for general CUAs. Starting from user personas and daily activities, WildAWM constructs executable personal-computer environments with websites, MCP services, and local files, then synthesizes cross-agent interface (XAI) tasks grounded in these worlds.
We introduce execution-based multi-agent quality gates, where heterogeneous agents from different models and harnesses execute each task, providing evidence of solvability, difficulty, and judge consistency.
To further test verifier robustness, we exploit LLM sycophancy ( Sharma et al., 2024 ) through counterfactual probes with deliberately incorrect outcome feedback.
The resulting environments, tasks, and verifiers provide executable worlds and rewards for agentic RL.
Notably, WildAWM uses open-source models throughout synthesis, whereas existing works often rely on proprietary models ( Aggarwal et al., 2026 ; Zhou, 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . This improves reproducibility, transparency, and accessibility, while showing that open-source models alone can synthesize high-quality environments and challenging tasks for general CUA training.

为了应付这些挑战,我们提议为普通海关总署提供可扩展的合成管道WildAWM。 从用户人物和日常活动开始,WildAWM用网站,MCP服务以及本地文件构建可执行的个人计算机环境,然后合成基于这些世界的跨代理界面(XAI)任务.

由此产生的环境、任务和核查者为代理RL提供了可执行的世界和奖励。

blocks.en:
Using WildAWM , we synthesize 341 environment–task pairs, each requiring at least three interface types, with long-horizon workflows that may require over 100 agent steps, and even frontier model GPT-6-Astra ( OpenAI, 2026c ) solves only about 60%.
We further perform online RL on two Qwen models, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) and Qwen3.5-4B ( Team, 2026 ) , using OpenCode CLI harness ( anomalyco, 2025 ) equipped with GUI and MCP tools, and find that training exclusively in these synthetic worlds yields substantial gains across all eight out-of-distribution (OOD) benchmarks spanning web, claw, and computer-use agents.
Our contributions are threefold: • We propose a scalable, fully open-source pipeline WildAWM for synthesizing CUA environments spanning GUI, CLI, and MCP interfaces. • We propose execution-based gates for synthesizing solvable, challenging tasks with reliable verifiers, together with the release of 341 environment–task pairs. • Experiment results demonstrate that training exclusively in worlds synthesized by open-source models can substantially improve the generalization performance of computer-use agents.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Computer-use agents interact with applications through GUIs ( Cheng et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) and programmatic representations such as HTML and accessibility trees ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2024 ) . GUI agents have been studied for web navigation ( He et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2026a ) , desktop automation ( Agashe et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2026b ) , and multi-application workflows ( Tan et al., 2024 ; Qin et al., 2025 ; OpenAI, 2025b ; Yang et al., 2026b ) .
Recent work expands this action space with CLI ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , coding ( Song et al., 2026 ) , and MCP tools ( Jia et al., 2025 ) , while harness-based agents expose heterogeneous tools through coding and claw-agent frameworks ( Yu et al., 2026 ; OpenClaw contributors, 2026 ; Anthropic, 2025 ; anomalyco, 2025 ) .
These trends suggest a broader view of computer use in which the agent is not bound to a particular interaction modality. In this work, we adopt this view and consider general CUAs that can jointly access GUI, CLI, and MCP interfaces as needed to complete any tasks on a personal computer.

计算机使用代理人通过GUI与应用交互(Cheng等人, 2024; 徐等人, 2024; 吴等人, 2025) 以及 HTML 和无障碍树等方案表述(周等人, 2024; He等人, 2024). 已研究了网页导航(He等人,2024年;Zheng等人,2024年;Yang等人,2026年a年),桌面自动化(Agashe等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2024年;Zhang等人,2025年a年;Wang等人,2026年b年)和多应用工作流程。 (Tan等人,2024年;秦等人,2025年;OpenAI,2025年b;杨等人,2026年b).
最近的工作拓展了这一行动空间,包括CLI(周等人,2026年),编码(宋等人,2026年),MCP工具(贾等人,2025年),而利用的剂通过编码和爪剂框架暴露出各种工具(Yu等人,2026年;OpenClaw贡献者,2026年;Anthropic,2025年;异常物,2025年)。
这些趋势表明,从更广泛的角度看待计算机的使用,即代理人不受某一特定互动模式的约束。 在这项工作中,我们采纳这种观点,并考虑可联合访问GUI,CLI和MCP接口的一般CUAs,以完成个人计算机上的任何任务.

blocks.en:
The growing demand for interactive agent training has motivated automatic construction of executable environments.
Recent work synthesizes executable environments for web interaction ( Zhou, 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) , tool use ( Wang et al., 2026d ; Du et al., 2026 ; Dong et al., 2026 ) , terminal interaction ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Ivison et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) , and software engineering ( Jain et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) .
For CUAs, GUI-GENESIS reconstructs lightweight web applications ( Cao et al., 2026 ) , WebArena-Infinity and CUA-Gym synthesize web environments and verifiable tasks ( Zhou, 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) , Gym-Anything converts existing software into agent environments ( Aggarwal et al., 2026 ) rather than building the environments, and CUA-Universe augments desktop applications with CLI access ( Shi et al., 2026 ) . Other work synthesizes user-specific computers with productivity artifacts ( Ge et al., 2026 ) .
As compared in Table 1 , WildAWM constructs a unified personal-computer world with joint GUI, MCP, and CLI access, combining WebHarbor’s visual web substrate ( WebHarbor Team, 2026 ) with synthesized services, files, and application data. Notably, WildAWM uses open-source models instead of proprietary frontier models, which can improve transparency and accessibility for the community.
blocks.zh:
对互动代理培训的需求不断增加,促使自动构建可执行环境。
最近的工作综合了网络互动的可执行环境(周,2026;吴等人,2026),工具使用(王等人,2026d; Du等人,2026年;Dong等人,2026年),终端相互作用(Zhu等人,2026年;Ivison等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年),软件工程(Jain等人,2025年;Yang等人,2025年;Chen等人,2026年).
对于CUA,GUI-GENESIS重建轻量级网络应用程序(Cao等人,2026年),WebArena-Infinity和CUA-Gym合成网络环境和可核查的任务(周,2026年;Wang等人,2026年a),Gym- 任何东西都会将现有的软件转换成代理环境(Aggarwal等人,2026年),而不是构建环境,而CUA-Universe会用CLI访问来增强桌面应用(Shi等人,2026年). 其他作品用生产力文物合成用户专用计算机(Ge等人,2026年).
与表1相比,WildAWM构建了一个统一的个人计算机世界,拥有GUI,MCP和CLI联合访问,将WebHarbor的视觉网络底板(WebHarbor Team,2026)与综合服务,文件和应用数据结合. 值得注意的是,WildAWM使用开源模型而不是专有前沿模型,这可以提高社区的透明度和无障碍性。

blocks.en:
Task generation has progressed from standalone instruction synthesis ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2023 ; Taori et al., 2023 ) to tasks grounded in executable environments ( Sun et al., 2024 ; Pahuja et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026c ) . Prior methods derive tasks from observed interactions ( Sun et al., 2024 ; Su et al., 2025 ) , environment exploration ( Pahuja et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026c ) , or programmatic generation ( Yang et al., 2025 ) .
More recent methods couple task synthesis with executable verification: WebArena-Infinity synthesizes difficulty-graded browser tasks with programmatic verifiers ( Zhou, 2026 ) , Agent World Model (AWM) ( Wang et al., 2026d ) exploits executable environment states to construct reliable rewards, CUA-Gym ( Wang et al., 2026a ) co-generates task, environment state, and reward as verified triples.
Beyond these approaches, WildAWM introduces a quality-control pipeline using heterogeneous agent rollouts, cross-judge consistency, and counterfactual probes to validate task solvability and difficulty while stress-testing the reliability of synthesized verifiers, all with open-source models.
blocks.zh:
任务生成已经从独立的指令合成(王等人,2023年;徐等人,2023年;陶里等人,2023年)发展到基于可执行环境的任务(孙等人,2024年;帕胡贾等人,2025年;王等人,2026年c). 先前的方法从观测到的相互作用(Sun等人,2024年;Su等人,2025年),环境勘探(Pahuja等人,2025年;Wang等人,2026年c)或方案生成(Yang等人,2025年)中得出任务.
更近代的方法将任务合成与可执行验证:WebArena-Infinity将难度级浏览器任务与程序验证器(周,2026),代理世界模型(AWM)(Wang等人,2026d)结合利用可执行环境状态构建可靠的奖励,CUA-Gym(Wang等人,2026a)共同生成任务,环境状态,以及被核实的三重奖励.
除这些办法外,WildAWM还采用了一种质量控制管道,采用多种不同物剂的推出、相互判断的一致性和反事实探测器,以验证任务的可溶性和难度,同时对合成核查器的可靠性进行压力测试,所有这一切都采用开源模型。

blocks.en: 3 Agent World Model in the Wild
blocks.zh: 3 野外世界模型代理

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 1 , WildAWM uses open-source models to synthesize executable environments and tasks for training general CUAs. Each synthesized instance contains a personal-computer environment initialized from a world state W W , a task τ \tau , and a verifier V V that evaluates task completion.

blocks.en: 3.1 World Synthesis
blocks.zh: 3.1 世界综合

blocks.en:
We define a world as the accumulated state of a personal computer which comprises web applications, MCP-accessible services, and local files that record a person’s activities.
To expand the range of multimodal GUI interaction, we integrate 15 mirror websites from WebHarbor ( WebHarbor Team, 2026 ) which provides website mirrors with rich visual content.
We first synthesize a persona and expand its ongoing activities into sequential day plans. Then, a coding agent materializes these plans day by day, with each day extending the previous state.
This procedure constructs applications and services, and produces diverse user histories, application data, and files.
We denote the cumulative state of persona c c after day d d as W ⁡ ( c , d ) W(c,d) , which initializes and resets the environment state.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en:
We first prompt the generator, a coding agent using GLM-5.2 ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) within OpenCode ( anomalyco, 2025 ) , to synthesize personas from scratch.
Each persona c c describes an occupation, named contacts, frequently used websites, and ongoing activities spanning multiple days.
To promote diversity, we compare each candidate with accepted personas in terms of life domain and multi-day storylines, then regenerate repeated candidates with feedback on identified similarities.
For each accepted persona, the generator further develops these storylines into a sequence of day plans.
Each plan specifies activities, the people and digital artifacts involved, the required applications and services, and the corresponding databases and files.
Planning proceed one day at a time: the generator would inspect previous day’s state W ⁡ ( c , d − 1 ) W(c,d-1) to maintain continuity with ongoing activities before planning day d d .
Then, the subsequent materialization stage would reuse existing application and service implementations and synthesize any artifacts that are missing.

blocks.en:
Given the day plan, the generator first matches its activities and required services against a growing library of reusable event skills and application implementations.
Each event skill specifies the interfaces involved, the state changes to produce, and the consistency constraints across the resulting records and files.
For example, a skill for a student enrolling in a Coursera course and completing assignments can encode the corresponding workflow and the required database and file updates.
The generator synthesizes a new skill if a plan introduces an activity not being covered by any existing skill.
Similarly, when a required MCP service is unavailable, it implements the corresponding database schema and backend, MCP servers.
These skills and service implementations will be added to the shared library for reuse in subsequent days and personas.
The generator starts from a clean state on day 0 or a copy of W ⁡ ( c , d − 1 ) W(c,d-1) thereafter.
It inspects the actual schemas and existing state, then writes a deterministic, replayable program that updates databases for MCP services and websites, and local files to produce W ⁡ ( c , d ) W(c,d) .
We retain such state only if two independent replays produce the same state, and all services and websites remain healthy.
Further, we launch another coding agent to verify the state is consistent with the day plan, and provide feedback for necessary revisions.

blocks.en: 3.2 XAI Task Synthesis
blocks.zh: 3.2 习近平 任务综述

blocks.en: Beyond environment synthesis, task generation faces three key challenges for agentic learning: ensuring solvability , maintaining sufficient difficulty , and generating reliable verifiers . We address them with an execution-based multi-agent validation loop, where heterogeneous open-source agents attempt each task and five quality gates use the resulting evidence for acceptance or revision.
blocks.zh: 除了环境综合之外,任务生成还面临着促进性学习的三大挑战:确保可溶性、保持足够的困难和产生可靠的核查器。 我们用一个基于执行的多代理验证循环来解决它们,其中不同的开源代理尝试每一项任务,五个质量门利用由此产生的证据接受或修改.

blocks.en:
Given an initial world state W 0 = W ⁡ ( c , d ) W_{0}=W(c,d) , the skill-enhanced generator explores the live environment and proposes cross-agent interface (XAI) tasks grounded in the available application data, service records, and local files. Each task requires the agent to use all three interfaces, i.e., GUI, MCP, and CLI. A diversity gate selects proposals that are least similar to tasks already accepted or being developed by concurrent workers. For each selected proposal, the generator produces a task specification τ \tau , an executable verifier V V , a rubric R R , and a hint h h , and a document that decomposes τ \tau into an ordered sequence of sub-tasks.
The verifier takes the initial world state W 0 W_{0} , the final world state W W , and the agent’s final answer a a as inputs. It evaluates a predefined checklist of N N binary criteria, where each criterion is given by v i ​ ( W 0 , W , a ) ∈ { 0 , 1 } v_{i}(W_{0},W,a)\in\{0,1\} . We define task success as satisfying all criteria: V ⁡ ( W 0 , W , a ) = ∏ i = 1 N v i ​ ( W 0 , W , a ) V(W_{0},W,a)=\prod_{i=1}^{N}v_{i}(W_{0},W,a) .
Individual criterion scores can provide granular feedback and value estimates for long-horizon RL training.

After generating a task and its verifier, we use heterogeneous agents to attempt each task: successful rollouts provide evidence of solvability, success rates characterize empirical difficulty, and their trajectories and outcomes help validate the verifier.
Specifically, we collect six rollouts per task, half with hints, from 18 model–harness pairs formed by three open-source models—GLM-5.2 ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) , DeepSeek-V4-Flash ( Xu et al., 2026 ) , and MiniMax-M3 ( MiniMax Team, 2026 ) —and six harnesses, comprising three coding agents (OpenCode ( anomalyco, 2025 ) , Codex ( OpenAI, 2025a ) , Claude Code ( Anthropic, 2025 ) ) and three claw agents (Nanobot ( Ren et al., 2026 ) , OpenClaw ( OpenClaw contributors, 2026 ) , Hermes Agent ( Nous Research, 2026 ) ).

具体来说,我们收集了每个任务的6个推出,其中一半带有提示,分别来自由3个开源模型形成的18个型号-harness配对——GLM-5.2(Zeng等人,2026年),DeepSeek-V4-Flash(Xu等人,2026年),以及MiniMax-M3(MiniMax团队,2026年)——和6个牵引装置,包括3个编码剂(OpenCode(异常物,2025年),Codex(OpenAI,2025a),Claude Code(Anthropic,2025年)和3个爪剂(Nanobot(Ren等人,2026年),OpenClaw(OpenClaw贡献者,2026年),Hermes Agent(Nous Research,2026年).

blocks.en: Table 3 shows a case study of an accepted task that illustrates these properties. The task asks an audio-visual technician commissioning a display wall for a sports bar to lock the production surge units for the rack before the install crew starts the swap. The owner’s approval sits in a chat thread from an earlier day of the world, and the workspace holds a rack inventory, a bill of materials, and a product specification sheet accumulated since day 0, so solving the task depends on state built up over the world’s history. The agent first confirms the go-ahead in the direct-message MCP service, then writes and runs a script via CLI in the terminal that joins the three local sources, ranks the candidate units by their specifications, and saves the shortlist. The GUI step happens on the storefront, where two candidates match on every listed specification and differ only in their visible design, so the agent must inspect the product images to identify the correct one. The bottom block of Table 3 reports the evidence collected at the five quality gates. The three levels of judgment agree on all six rollouts, all four checks fail on the initial state, one of the three hinted rollouts completes the task, and none of the three unhinted rollouts does, so the task is classified as hard. Under the counterfactual probe, the agent judge insists on its original verdict. See more examples in Appendix C .

blocks.en:
In summary, candidates that fail any gate are returned to the generator with diagnostic evidence for up to two revision rounds, after which they must re-pass all gates.
Accepted tasks are added to the diversity pool, while failed ones provide lessons to be absorbed into generator’s evolving skills.
Table 4 and Figure 2 summarize synthesis statistics and candidate progression, with stage-by-stage details and prompts in Appendix A.4 . During rollouts, XAI tasks have a mean success rate of only 21.3%, and even GLM-5.2 sometimes requires more than 100 steps to complete a task. Consistent with the solvability and difficulty gates, every accepted task is solved by at least one agent, while none is solved by all agents.
XAI tasks consists of 4.2 4.2 sub-tasks and 3.1 3.1 interface switches on average, and 74.5% revisit a previously used interface, requiring agents to preserve state across interface transitions rather than completing the task within a single interface.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en:
We synthesized 341 XAI tasks by WildAWM , and we randomly split them into 100 for SFT, 208 for RL, and 33 for in-domain evaluation.
To evaluate the OOD generalization of our agent, we further include 8 benchmarks across 3 categories of agent tasks:
WebArena (WA) ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) and Online-Mind2Web (O2W) ( Xue et al., 2025 ) for web agents; QwenClawBench (QCB) ( Qwen Team & Alibaba Data, 2026 ) and ClawEval (CLE) ( Ye et al., 2026 ) for claw agents; CUA-Gym (CUG) ( Wang et al., 2026a ) , OSWorld-Verified (OSV) ( Xie et al., 2024 ) , OSWorld 2.0 (OS-2) ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) , and Agents’ Last Exam (ALE) ( Sun et al., 2026 ) for computer-use agents.

我们通过WildAWM合成了341 XAI的任务,我们随机将其分为100为SFT,208为RL,33为域内评价.
为了评估我们代理人的OO概况,我们进一步包括了三类代理人任务的8项基准:
WebArena(WA)(周等人,2024年)和Online-Mind2Web(O2W)(薛等人,2025年)用于网络代理;QuenClaw Bench(QCB)(Quen Team & Alibaba Data,2026年)和ClawEval(CLE)(Ye等人,2026年)用于爪牙代理;CUA-Gym(CUG)(王等人,2026年a年),OSWorld-Verife(OSV)(Xie等人,2024年),OSWorld2.0(OS-2)(袁等人,2026年)和Agents ' Last Exam(ALE)(Sun等人,2026年)用于计算机使用代理.

blocks.en:
We use two base models at different scales for training: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) and Qwen3.5-4B ( Team, 2026 ) .
We compare our trained models against a range of frontier models, including GPT-6-Astra ( OpenAI, 2026c ) , GPT-5.6-Sol ( OpenAI, 2026b ) , GPT-5.5 ( OpenAI, 2026a ) , Claude Opus 5 ( Anthropic, 2026b ) , Claude Opus 4.8 ( Anthropic, 2026a ) , and GLM-5.2 ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) .
We also include numbers reported in prior computer-use agent work for reference, including CUA-Gym ( Wang et al., 2026a ) and OpenForgeRL ( Yu et al., 2026 ) . 2 2 2 For reference only, due to their unavailable checkpoints or evaluation with traditional GUI harnesses.

我们使用两种不同规模的基本模式进行培训: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B(Quen Team,2026年)和Qwen3.5-4B(Team,2026年).
我们比较了经过训练的模型和一系列前沿模型,包括GPT-6-Astra(OpenAI,2026c),GPT-5.6-Sol(OpenAI,2026b),GPT-5.5(OpenAI,2026a),克劳德·奥普斯5(Anthropic,2026b),克劳德·奥普斯4.8(Anthropic,2026a),以及GLM-5.2(Zeng等人,2026).
我们还包括以前计算机使用代理工作报告的数字,包括CUA-Gym(Wang等人,2026年a)和OpenForgeRL(Yu等人,2026年). 2 2, 仅供参考,因为它们没有检查站或用传统的GUI工具进行评估。

blocks.en:
We use 8 NVIDIA B200 GPUs for both synthesis and training.
During synthesis, we use GLM-5.2 as both the generator and the agent-as-a-judge with OpenCode harness ( anomalyco, 2025 ) . For evaluation, we use OpenCode equipped with GUI (e.g., click and type ) and MCP (e.g., Playwright) tools, and enable high reasoning effort for the model.
The maximum number of agent steps is set to 256 for most benchmarks and 512 for OSWorld 2.0 and ALE.
The context window is set to 100K tokens with automatic context compaction.
For training, we first construct a seed dataset by collecting 100 GLM-5.2 trajectories on the SFT split, and warm-start the Qwen base models with SFT for 3 epochs.
We then perform RL for up to 64 training steps, using a batch size of 8 tasks and G = 4 G=4 rollouts per task.
Environment management and RL training are built on Orchard ( Peng et al., 2026 ) and slime ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) . More details are in Appendix A .

blocks.en:
Table 5 summarizes the main results. We highlight three key findings.
(1) Broad OOD generalization. Training exclusively in WildAWM ’s synthesized worlds improves both model scales on all eight benchmarks, spanning web, claw, and computer-use agents. The 35B-A3B and 4B models gain + 10.58 +10.58 and + 8.21 +8.21 points on average, respectively, demonstrating broad transfer across unseen tasks and scenarios.
(2) Larger models benefit more. The 35B-A3B model improves more than the 4B model on average ( + 10.58 +10.58 vs. + 8.21 +8.21 ), with particularly large gains on CLE ( + 16.67 +16.67 ), OSV ( + 16.06 +16.06 ), WebArena ( + 13.72 +13.72 ), and CUG ( + 12.22 +12.22 ). This suggests that the benefits of WildAWM ’s long-horizon, cross-interface supervision persist, and may even increase, at larger model capacity.
(3) Narrowing the gap to frontier models. WildAWM raises the 35B-A3B model’s average score from 42.84 42.84 to 53.42 53.42 , substantially reducing its gap to the listed frontier models.
The resulting model further matches GLM-5.2 on WebArena ( 67.26 67.26 ) and exceeds GPT-5.5 on O2W ( 80.77 80.77 vs. 72.22 72.22 ).

(2) 较大的模型受益更多。 35B-A3B型平均比4B型(+10.58+10.58 vs. +8.21+8.21)改进得更多,在CLE(+16.67+16.67),OSV(+16.06+16.06),WebArena(+13.72+13.72),CUG(+12.22+12.22)上获得特别大的收益,这表明WildAWM的长视线,跨面监督,在更大的模型容量上持续,甚至可能增加.
(3)将差距缩小到前沿模式。 WildAWM将35B-A3B模型的平均得分从42.84 42.84提高到53.42 53.42,大大缩小了与所列前沿模型的差距.
由此产生的模型在WebArena(67.26 67.26)上进一步匹配GLM-5.2,在O2W(80.77 80.77对72.22 72.22.)上超过了GPT-5.5.

blocks.en: 5.1 Synthesis Quality
blocks.zh: 5.1 综合质量

blocks.en:
A WildAWM ’s environment state accumulates a persona’s activities over multiple days, with a median size of 52.4K tokens, while CUA-Gym uses task-specific injected states with a median size of only 1.1K tokens.
Despite its substantially larger environment scale, WildAWM is also more diverse.
As shown in Figure 3 , we find that WildAWM achieves consistently higher Vendi score across all sample sizes. Its higher nearest-neighbor cosine distance (0.25 vs. 0.20) further indicates lower redundancy.
Notably, we achieve these gains using only open-source models, whereas most existing work relies on proprietary frontier models for synthesis.
blocks.zh:
WildAWM的环境状态在多日内累积一个人a的活动,中位大小为52.4K令牌,而CUA-Gym则使用任务特定注射状态,中位大小仅为1.1K令牌.
尽管WAWM的环境规模大得多,但它也更加多样化。
如图3所示,我们发现WildAWM在所有样本规模上都取得了一贯较高的Vendi分数。 其较高的近邻宇宙距离(0.25对0.20)进一步表明冗余程度较低.
值得注意的是,我们仅利用开源模型来实现这些收益,而大多数现有工作则依赖于专有前沿模型进行合成。

blocks.en:
We answer these important task synthesis questions:
(1) Are XAI tasks solvable? Rather than relying on a single strong model as evidence of solvability, we evaluate each task with 24 heterogeneous agents (model–harness pairs). As shown in Figure 3 , every task is solved by at least one agent, while the three open-source models alone used during synthesis already solve over 95% of tasks. Figure 3 further evaluates our hints using only these open-source models. With hints, every task is solved by at least one of the three models, and 51.5% by all three, providing stronger evidence that XAI tasks are solvable through executable paths.
(2) Are XAI tasks challenging, even for frontier models? We evaluate frontier and open-source models on synthesized tasks to assess task difficulty in Figure 4 , and find that GPT-6-Astra achieves only about 60% pass@1 , while our trained agents approach the performance of GLM-5.2 with substantially fewer parameters.
Figure 4 shows that difficulty persists under test-time scaling: even after eight attempts, GPT-6-Astra still fails on 27.3% of tasks and passˆk drops rapidly, indicating that open-source-synthesized tasks remain challenging enough and could even provide useful training signals for frontier models.
(3) Are synthesized verifiers reliable? We compare our verifier against multiple agent-as-a-judge models on 100 randomly sampled rollouts in Table 7 .
Our verifier achieves 95% agreement with the majority, with a Cohen’s κ \kappa of 0.90, suggesting that our verifier is reliable within natural variation of stronger but heavier agent-as-a-judge judgments.
(4) Is the synthesis pipeline scalable? As shown in Figure 4 , synthesis continues to expand task coverage, reaching 134 domains and 91 task types at a 53% acceptance rate without clear saturation.
Meanwhile, mean pairwise cosine distance remains stable as the pool grows, suggesting that increased coverage does not come from increasingly similar tasks.
blocks.zh:
我们回答了这些重要的任务综述问题:
(1) XAI的任务是否可以解决? 我们没有依赖单一的强大模型作为可溶性的证据,而是用24种不同物剂(模范-harness pairs)来评估每项任务。 如图3所示,每个任务都至少由一个代理解决,而合成过程中单独使用的3个开源模型已经解决了95%以上的任务. 图3 仅使用这些开源模型进一步评估我们的提示. 有了提示,每个任务都由三个模型中至少一个解决,51.5%由所有三个模型解决,这提供了更强有力的证据,证明XAI任务可以通过可执行路径溶解.
(2) 即使对前沿模式而言,XAI的任务是否具有挑战性? 我们评价关于综合任务的前沿和开源模型,以评估图4中的任务难度,并发现GPT-6-Astra只实现了约60%的通过@1,而我们受过训练的特工则以少得多的参数接近GLM-5.2的性能.
图4显示,在测试时间缩放下,困难依然存在:即使在8次尝试之后,GPT-6-Astra仍然在27.3%的任务上失败,并且通过QQk迅速下降,这表明开源合成的任务仍然具有足够的挑战性,甚至可以为前沿模型提供有用的培训信号.
(3) 合成核查器是否可靠? 我们在表7的100个随机抽样中, 将我们的核查人与多个现成代理人模型进行比较。
我们的核查人与多数人达成了95%的协议,科恩的0.90美分,表明我们的核查人在更强但更重的代理法官判决的自然变化中是可靠的。
(4) 合成管道可伸缩吗? 如图4所示,综合继续扩大任务覆盖范围,达到134个域和91个任务类型,接受率为53%,没有明显的饱和度.
同时,随着池子的扩大,平均双环余弦距离保持稳定,这表明扩大覆盖范围并非来自日益相似的任务。

blocks.en: 5.2 Ablations on Quality Gates
blocks.zh: 5.2 质量门缺陷

blocks.en:
To isolate the contribution of each synthesis gate, we synthesize SFT data with one gate removed at a time and train Qwen3.5-4B model under an identical settings.
As shown in Table 7 , the full quality-control strategy achieves the best overall performance, while removing any gate reduces the average by 2.60–9.30 points.
Judge Consistency and Initial Unsatisfaction are particularly important: removing them drops the average to 22.56 and 24.08, respectively, and reduces performance on in-domain validation set from 21.59 to only 3.79 and 3.05.
Task Difficulty also contributes substantially, with its removal decreasing the validation score to 7.58.
These results show that five gates are complementary: together they produce more reliable training data and substantially improve both in-domain task learning and generalization performance on OOD benchmarks.

为了隔离每个合成门的贡献,我们用一次移除一个门来合成SFT数据,并在相同的设置下训练Quen3.5-4B型号.
如表7所示,全面质量控制战略取得了最佳的整体业绩,同时拆除任何门将平均减少2.6-9.30分。
法官一致性和初步不满意尤其重要:删除它们分别将平均值降至22.56和24.08,并将域内验证的性能从21.59降至3.79和3.05。
任务难度也大有帮助,删除后,验证分降至7.58。
这些结果表明,五个门户是相辅相成的:它们共同产生更可靠的培训数据,并大大改进国内任务学习和OD基准的概括性表现。

blocks.en: 5.3 Ablations on RL

blocks.en:
We ablate key components of our RL recipe to measure their impact in Table 8 , and find that removing format penalty cause significant drop in WA and OSV, while its higher CLE pass rate is not matched by a higher CLE mean score (69.89 vs. 69.45 WildAWM ), i.e., more tasks end just above the pass threshold.
We conjecture that the format reward is particularly important for GUI agents, where actions must be correctly parsed to interact with visual interfaces.
Without checklist partial credit, performance decreases on most benchmarks, indicating that the denser reward improves credit assignment. Notably, removing the warm start causes the largest degradation, highlighting the importance of a strong initialization for effective RL training at this small model scale.

我们猜想格式奖励对于GUI代理来说特别重要,其中动作必须正确解析才能与视觉界面交互.
由于没有核对表的部分信用,大多数基准的绩效都会下降,这表明较密集的奖励可以改善信用分配。 特别是,消除温暖的开端造成最大的退化,突出表明了强有力的初始化对于在这种小规模模式下进行有效的生殖健康培训的重要性。

blocks.en: 5.4 Policy Behavior Analysis

blocks.en:
Figure 5 compares trajectories from base model, WildAWM , and three variants: SFT, which fine-tunes on trajectories from GLM-5.2 (the initialization checkpoint of WildAWM ), RFT ( Yuan et al., 2023 ) , which fine-tunes on base model’s own successful trajectories instead of GLM-5.2 demonstrations, and +RL, which applies the same RL directly to base model without SFT.
(1) Gains concentrate on tasks within the teacher’s reach. We divide OOD tasks into difficulty quartiles and find that WildAWM gains most on the second and third quartiles ( + 19.9 +19.9 and + 12.2 +12.2 points), where RL adds another 5.0 and 1.3 points over SFT. In contrast, +RL improves by only 6.7 and 8.7 points. On the hardest quartile, which is also challenging for the teacher, no variant shows a clear gain.
(2) Cross-interface interaction is learned from the teacher. The interface-switch rate rises from 18.4% to 24.7% after SFT and 25.5% after RL, approaching GLM-5.2. In contrast, RFT and +RL reduce it to 15.8% and 15.7%, respectively.
(3) RL adds long-horizon capability beyond SFT. SFT and WildAWM solve similar fractions of tasks within 40 steps (34.9% vs. 36.8%), but between 40 and 120 steps SFT gains only 9.7 points while WildAWM gains 17.0, close to the teacher. +RL also gains 15.2 points, but starts lower and reaches only 47.2% within 120 steps versus 53.7% for WildAWM . Overall, teacher trajectories transfer cross-interface behavior through SFT, while RL adds long-horizon problem solving most effectively on top of this initialization.
More details are in Appendix B .

(2)从老师那里学到交叉交互. 接口开关率在SFT之后从18.4%上升到24.7%,在RL之后从25.5%上升到接近GLM-5.2. 相比之下,RFT和+RL分别将其降低到15.8%和15.7%.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we propose WildAWM , a scalable pipeline for synthesizing executable worlds and tasks for general computer-use agents. In contrast to existing approaches often centered on a single application or single agent interface, our method constructs personal-computer environments spanning GUI, MCP, and CLI, and generates cross-interface tasks grounded in accumulated world states. We introduce execution-based quality gates for task solvability, difficulty, and verifier reliability. The entire synthesis and validation pipeline uses open-source models, enabling transparent, high-quality generation without relying on any proprietary frontier models.
Using WildAWM , we synthesize 341 long-horizon tasks and train two Qwen models exclusively in these synthetic worlds. The resulting agents improve consistently across all eight out-of-distribution benchmarks spanning web, claw, and computer-use agents, demonstrating broad transfer beyond the synthetic environments. We believe that WildAWM offers a promising path toward open-source models generating scalable synthetic worlds, learning within them, and ultimately becoming powerful general computer-use agents.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们提出WildAWM,这是一个可扩展的管道,用于合成可执行的世界和一般计算机使用代理人的任务。 与通常以单一应用程序或单一代理界面为中心的现有方法不同,我们的方法构建了跨越GUI、MCP和CLI的个人计算机环境,并产生基于累积世界国家的交叉界面任务。 我们采用了基于执行的质量门,用于任务可溶解性、难度和核查可靠性。 整个合成和验证管道采用开源模型,能够实现透明,高质量的生成,而不依赖于任何专有的前沿模型.
使用WildAWM,我们合成了341个长视距任务,并专门在这些合成世界训练两个Quen模型. 由此产生的物剂在覆盖网络、爪子和计算机使用物剂的所有8项分配外基准方面都不断改进,显示出超出合成环境的广泛转移。 我们认为,WildAWM提供了一条通向开源模型的有希望的道路,这些模型产生可扩展的合成世界,在其中学习,并最终成为强大的一般计算机使用剂。

blocks.en: A.1 Evaluation Benchmarks
blocks.zh: A.1 评价基准

blocks.en:
We evaluate across 8 out-of-distribution benchmarks spanning web, claw, and computer-use agent tasks.
Considering existing works often evaluate on 2–4 benchmarks ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Shi et al., 2026 ; Ge et al., 2026 ) , our evaluation suite is among the most comprehensive in the literature, we evaluate on a specific subset rather than the full task set of several benchmarks for evaluation efficiency. Table 9 summarizes the task count, scoring metric, and pass criterion for each benchmark.
To reduce computational cost and accelerate inference, we also apply NVFP4 quantization to all open-source models used during both synthesis and evaluation.
Throughout all benchmarks, we use GPT-5.5 ( OpenAI, 2026a ) as the judge model if the task or evaluator requires an LLM judge.
All benchmarks except for Online-Mind2Web and WebArena are evaluated through Docker hosted via Orchard ( Peng et al., 2026 ) . For any infra errors (e.g., network issues, Docker issues), we allow up to 3 retries per attempt, otherwise we exclude these attempts from the scoring. For timeout errors (1 hour limit in default per task), we still count them as valid attempts and run the judgments.
We describe each benchmark in detail below.

考虑到现有工作往往按2-4个基准进行评估(Wang等人,2026a); Shi等人,2026年;Ge等人,2026年),我们的评价套件属于文献中最全面的套件,我们评价的是特定子集,而不是评价效率的若干基准的全部任务套件. 表9汇总每个基准的任务数、评分指标和通过标准。

在所有基准中,如果任务或评估人员需要一名LLM法官,我们就使用GPT-5.5(OpenAI,2026a)作为法官模型。
除Online-Mind2Web和WebArena外,所有基准都通过通过Orcard托管的Docker进行评审(Peng等人,2026年). 对于任何以下错误(例如网络问题,Docker问题),我们允许每次尝试最多3次重试,否则将这些尝试排除在评分之外. 对于超时错误(每个任务缺一小时限),我们仍然把它们算作有效的尝试并运行判断.

blocks.en: A.2 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: A.2 评价议定书

blocks.en:
All evaluations use OpenCode ( anomalyco, 2025 ) CLI harness (v1.17.7) as the agent runtime. The agent operates autonomously with no interactive user. We use a brief prompt to instruct it to complete the task using available native, MCP, browser, shell, and file tools, choosing each interface based on the operation’s required capability rather than following a fixed priority. This joint action space distinguishes WildAWM from prior work that typically equips agents with only one interface type. Upon task completion, the agent writes a marker file and stops.
OpenCode harness provides built-in tools for file operations ( read , write , edit , glob , grep ) and shell execution ( bash ). Shell execution enables the agent to run arbitrary commands and scripts such as python.
Several interactive tools are disabled during evaluation: task , question , plan_enter , plan_exit , todowrite , webfetch , and websearch .
blocks.zh:
所有评价都使用OpenCode(异常co,2025年) CLI cape(v1.17.7)作为代理运行时间. 代理机在无交互式用户的情况下自主运行. 我们使用一个简短的提示来指示它使用可用的本地,MCP,浏览器, shell,和文件工具来完成任务,根据操作所需的能力选择每个接口,而不是遵循固定的优先级. 这个联合行动空间区分了WildAWM与以前的工作,后者通常只为代理机配备一个接口类型. 任务完成后,代理写一个标记文件并停止.
OpenCode tape为文件操作(读、写、编辑、glob、grep)和 shell 执行(bash)提供了内置工具。 Shell执行使代理能够运行任意命令和脚本,如python.
多个交互工具在评价时被禁用:任务,问,计划_enter,计划_exit,todowrite ,webfatch,以及web搜索.

blocks.en: For benchmarks involving graphical interfaces, the agent accesses GUI through two complementary mechanisms: • Playwright (v0.0.78): exposes browser automation actions including navigation, element interaction ( click , type , select_option ), content extraction ( get_text , get_attribute ), and page management. • Browser-use CLI (v0.13.6): provides headless Chromium-based web automation as a command-line tool, complementing the Playwright interface for scenarios requiring programmatic browser control. For desktop benchmarks such as OSWorld, the agent additionally accesses a custom tool set that exposes fine-grained desktop control: screenshot , accessibility_tree , click , type_text , scroll , keyboard and mouse primitives ( hotkey , key_down , key_up , mouse_down , mouse_up , move ), and in-guest execution ( guest_bash , guest_python ).

blocks.en: Some evaluated policy models may not natively support multimodal input. To enable visual perception, we provide a vision tool that bridges the text-only policy model with visual content. The tool accepts a file path to an image and returns a text description generated by a separate vision-language model (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) ). This allows the agent to interpret screenshots and images to finish GUI related operations.

blocks.en: A.3 World Synthesis Details
blocks.zh: A.3 世界综合细节

blocks.en:
The world synthesis pipeline constructs persona-specific, multi-day environments through a sequence of coding-agent stages, each governed by a constitution (system prompt) that constrains the agent’s deliverables and quality criteria.
We integrate 15 websites from WebHarbor into our day 0 world: AllRecipes, Amazon, Apple, Arxiv, BBC News, Booking, Cambridge Dictionary, Coursera, Espn, Github, Google Search, Google Flights, Google Map, HuggingFace and WolframAlpha, in order to provide visual web substrate and image content for following synthesis.
All stages use GLM-5.2 ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) with the OpenCode harness ( anomalyco, 2025 ) . We summarize the key prompts used for world synthesis and task synthesis in Tables 11 and 12 , respectively.
The resulting world and task synthesis statistics are summarized in Tables 2 and 4 in the main text, respectively.
blocks.zh:
世界合成管道通过一系列编码代理阶段构建个性化的多日环境,每个阶段都受制约代理人可达到的目标和质量标准的宪法(系统即时)制约。
我们把来自WebHarbor的15个网站整合到我们这一天的0世界:All Recipes, Amazon, Apple, Arxiv, BBC新闻, 预订,剑桥词典, Coursera, Espn, Github, Google 搜索, Google Flights, Google Map, HuggingFace 和 Wolfram Alpha),为后续合成提供视觉网络底物和图像内容.
所有阶段都使用GLM-5.2(Zeng等人,2026年)与OpenCode(异常co,2025年)的牵引装置. 我们分别在表11和表12中总结了用于世界综合和任务综合的关键提示。
由此产生的世界和任务综合统计数据分别摘要载于正文表2和表4。

blocks.en:
The persona creator agent receives a constitution instructing it to generate a “persona bible” for one specific, realistic person.
The agent must first ground itself in the real application catalog by inspecting the 15 WebHarbor seed databases and the current shared MCP-application index to ensure the persona’s digital activities reference entities that actually exist ( i.e. , real products, courses, hotels from the seed catalogs). A fresh run starts with no MCP services: each persona defines a grounded roadmap of 4 to 8 services tied to concrete story arcs, and a dedicated application-creator stage implements each missing service on first use and publishes it to the shared library for reuse across later days and personas.
The deliverable includes a structured persona profile (demographics, relationship network of ≥ \geq 3 named contacts, tools and services, multi-day story arcs with at least one image-decisive arc), web account credentials with deterministic password hashes, and a compact signature for the diversity gate.
To enforce diversity, accepted personas are checked against all prior ones by an LLM diversity judge that rejects candidates sharing the same occupation and life domain, the same core tool or site usage pattern, or the same narrative arc as any existing persona (the 2nd row in Table 11 ). Rejected candidates receive diagnostic feedback and may be revised up to two times before final rejection.
blocks.zh:
创造者接受宪法指示,为一个具体、现实的人制作一本“个人圣经”。
代理商必须首先检查15个WebHarbor种子数据库和当前共享的MCP应用索引,以确保人物的数字活动参考实体实际存在(即种子目录中的真实产品、课程、酒店),从而在真正的应用目录中扎根。 新的运行开始时没有MCP服务:每个人a 定义了4到8个与混凝土故事弧相连的基于底线的路线图,一个专用的应用程序创建器阶段在第一次使用时执行每一次缺失的服务,并发布到共享的库中,供后期和人物再使用.
交付品包括结构化人物简介(人口、\\ geq 3 的关系网络命名联系人、工具和服务、至少有一个图像决定性弧的多日故事弧)、有确定密码散列的网络账户证书,以及多样性门的紧凑签名。
为了实现多样性,接受的人由LLM多样性法官与所有先前的人进行核对,该法官拒绝具有相同职业和生活领域、相同核心工具或地点使用模式或与任何现有人相同的叙事弧(表11第二行)的候选人。 被拒绝的候选人得到诊断反馈,在最后拒绝之前最多可修订两次。

blocks.en: For each accepted persona, days are planned sequentially. The day planner agent receives the persona bible, prior day plans, and read access to the actual cumulative world state through day N − 1 N{-}1 . It outputs a markdown plan covering computer use activities, MCP service events with continuity (e.g., thread replies, calendar updates), and web GUI actions referencing real catalog entities. The plan also includes coverage pressure: a per-app and per-site usage histogram from prior days that encourages the planner to diversify interface usage across days. The plan also carries a machine-readable mapping from each activity to shared event skills and MCP applications. Before materialization, a skill-creator stage authors any missing skill, and an application-creator stage implements a missing service or publishes a backward-compatible revision to the shared library.
blocks.zh: 对每个被接受的人a,按顺序计划天数。 日规划员接收人a圣经,前日计划,并读取通过日N−1N{}1读取实际累积世界状态. 它输出一个包含计算机使用活动,具有连续性的MCP服务事件(如线程回复,日历更新),以及参考真实目录实体的网页图形用户界面行动等的降标计划. 该计划还包括覆盖压力:前几天的每个应用程序和每个地点的使用情况直方图,鼓励规划人员将界面使用多样化,日复一日。 该计划还载有从每项活动到共享事件技能和MCP应用的机器可读绘图. 在实现前,一个技能创造器阶段会写出任何缺失的技能,而一个应用程序创造器阶段会执行缺失的服务,或者出版一个向后兼容的版本给共享库.

blocks.en:
The day implementer is a “god-mode” coding agent that materializes a day plan into a deterministic, replayable delta. It runs inside a live, booted world instance with full access to MCP services, WebHarbor databases, and the filesystem. The key deliverable is a delta.sh script (with deterministic Python sub-scripts) that, replayed hermetically over the day N − 1 N{-}1 state, reproduces day N N identically every time. Determinism is enforced through several hard constraints: timestamps must be frozen literals (never datetime.now() ), IDs must be derived ( MAX(id)+1 ), inserts must be idempotent, and passwords must use fixed-salt hashes from the persona’s accounts.json . When the plan requires unavailable functionality, the implementer may produce an overlay containing new MCP servers or WebHarbor code patches.
Note that every world instance reuses a common application layer while maintaining isolated copies of their mutable state, including service databases, website histories, and local files.
blocks.zh:
日执行者是一个“god-mode”编码代理商,它将一个日计划变成一个决定性的、可重复播放的三角洲。 它运行在一个活泼的,启动的世界实例中,完全可以访问MCP服务,WebHarbor数据库以及文件系统. 密钥可交付是一个delta.sh脚本(带有决定性的Python下标),在一天的N−1 N{}1状态下以超音速重播,每一次同样复制一天的N. 定时性通过几个硬约束来强制实施:时间戳必须被冻结的字元(绝不是日期时间.now()),ID必须被生成(MAX(id)+1),插入必须具有二元性,密码必须使用个人账户中的固定盐散列. 强森。 当计划需要不可用的功能时,执行者可能会产生包含新的MCP服务器或WebHarbor代码补丁的覆盖.
请注意,每个世界实例都重复使用一个共同的应用层,同时保留其可变状态的单独副本,包括服务数据库、网站历史和当地文件。

blocks.en: Each materialized day undergoes a layered gate before acceptance: 1. Deterministic lint : the delta’s scripts pass static checks, including a cross-persona identity check that rejects names already reserved by other personas. 2. Replay determinism : delta.sh is replayed twice from the same day N − 1 N{-}1 state; the two resulting worlds must produce identical content hashes. 3. Declaration verification : every database write, web write, account, file, and cross-reference declared in produces.json is verified against the materialized world; a declared artifact that is missing or unchanged fails the day. 4. Live health : the world is booted, every declared web account logs in with the persona’s credentials and its history page renders, and all active MCP services load; the gate also verifies that the persona’s web credentials are discoverable in the workspace so that a solver can later sign in as the persona. 5. Reviewer agent : an independent coding agent running on the host (outside the implementer’s container) inspects the materialized snapshot against the day plan, verifying MCP events, web GUI state, files, and determinism.
blocks.zh: 每一实现的一天在接受之前都要经过一层的大门: 1. 决定因素:三角洲的文字通过静态检查,包括拒绝他人已经保留的名字的跨人身份检查。 2. 重播定理论 : delta.sh从同一天N−1 N{}1状态重播两次;两个产生的世界必须产生相同的内容散列. 3. 申报核查:每个数据库书写、网络书写、账户、文件和产品申报的相互参照。 json与现实世界相对应;一个已宣布的文物丢失或未变的日落。 4. 现场健康:世界被启动,每个已申报的网络账户记录与人物的证书及其历史页一起制作,所有活跃的MCP服务负载;大门还验证人物的网络证书可以在工作空间中发现,以便解题者日后能够作为人物签名。 5. 审查者代理:在主机(执行者集装箱外)上运行的独立编码代理,对照日常计划检查已实现的快照,核实MCP事件、网络图形用户界面状态、文件和确定性。

blocks.en: Table 10 lists the 36 synthesized personas. Each persona profile lists 3 to 15 websites, 4 to 8 MCP services, and 2 to 5 multi-day story arcs, and each persona is materialized into 8 to 30 world states, 640 in total. Figure 6 shows the distribution of the 341 accepted tasks over personas and days. Every persona contributes at least two tasks, including at least one hard task, and the median is 5 tasks per persona. The six personas with the most tasks are the first six synthesized personas and account for 178 tasks. This concentration follows the order of synthesis. We first developed and tested the task synthesis pipeline on these six personas, so they were available for task synthesis over a longer period and received more synthesis attempts. The remaining 30 personas were then synthesized together with their world states and tasks, and each of them contributes 2 to 14 accepted tasks, 163 in total. Task synthesis runs at most three task slots per world state, and 246 of the 640 world states host at least one accepted task. The number of tasks per day follows the number of personas that have a world state on that day (Pearson r = 0.90 r=0.90 ), and 262 tasks come from days 0 to 13, on which at least 33 personas have a world state.

blocks.en: A.4 XAI Task Synthesis Details
blocks.zh: A.4 XAI 任务综合细节

blocks.en: Task synthesis proceeds in stages: sketch generation, diversity-driven selection, full task authoring with self-check, multi-agent rollouts, three-level judgment, and five quality gates including the counterfactual probe. Failed candidates receive diagnostic feedback and may undergo up to two fix iterations before rejection.
blocks.zh: 任务合成分阶段进行:草图生成,多样性驱动选择,全任务编写与自查,多代理推出,三级判断,包括反事实探测器在内的五个质量门. 不及格的考生得到诊断反馈,在被拒绝前最多可进行两次修复迭代。

blocks.en: Given a live world at day d d , the sketch agent explores the live environment within a wall-clock budget and proposes up to four diverse cross-interface task sketches; no exploration order, action count, or stop point is prescribed. The prompt provides a clean workspace file index and source previews. Each sketch shall require all three interfaces (CLI, MCP, web), each indispensable, and must require the solver to write and run a script or command-line program over a real user-visible source or an MCP export, whose result drives a later MCP or Web decision.
blocks.zh: 鉴于在d天的活世界,草图代理在墙上小时的预算范围内探索活环境,并提出了最多4个不同的交叉任务草图;没有规定勘探命令,动作计数,或停止点. 提示提供了干净的工作空间文件索引和源预览. 每个草图都需要所有三个接口(CLI,MCP,web),每个接口都是不可或缺的,并且必须要求解析器在真实的用户可见源或MCP导出上编写和运行一个脚本或命令行程序,其结果驱动后来的MCP或Web决定.

blocks.en: Sketch selection is performed by an LLM diversity judge that selects the candidate adding the most topical variety relative to already-accepted and concurrently locked tasks, rejecting near-duplicates that share the same core action and artifacts. (the 2nd row in Table 12 ).
blocks.zh: Sketch选择由 LLM 多样性法官进行,该法官会选择候选人,与已经接受和同时锁定的任务相比,添加最热门的品种,拒绝相同核心动作和文物的近似重复. (表12中的第2行).

blocks.en:
The generator agent receives the chosen sketch, a live capability contract generated from the world’s active MCP packages, schemas, and WebHarbor databases, and a detailed constitution (the first row in Table 12 ) defining the validity rules for XAI tasks: all three interfaces are mandatory and each must be indispensable.
The task is at most 300 words, and secrecy discipline separates the solver-visible task.md from the pipeline-internal reason.md / meta.json . The agent outputs seven artifacts: task.md (natural first-person request), reason.md (rationale), meta.json (structured metadata), golden.py (reference completion that reproduces the observable state of a faithful solver), rubrics.md , verify.skill.md , and deterministic verifier scripts composing an SDK of diff primitives. A mandatory self-check loop validates all artifacts until convergence. The rollout hint is derived from reason.md by a separate model call.

blocks.en: The heavy agent-as-a-judge runs with full permission of shell tools and vision access, inspecting BEFORE and AFTER world snapshots. Its constitution enforces strict evidence provenance: agent-authored text is admissible only as the deliverable itself, never as proof of an external fact. For visual requirements, the judge must independently call describe_image on ground-truth served images rather than trusting the agent’s claims. It classifies every false deterministic check as either too-strict (brittle verifier) or genuine-miss (real failure) (the fourth row in Table 12 ).
blocks.zh: 重任法官在完全允许使用外壳工具和视觉访问的情况下运行,检查前期和AFTER世界快照。 其章程规定严格的证据来源:代理作者的文本只能作为交付品本身接受,而不能作为外部事实的证据。 对于视觉要求,法官必须独立调用地面真实图像上的描述_图像,而不是相信代理商的说法。 它将每一个虚假的确定性检查归类为过于严格(britle verifier)或真错(real-issue)(表12中的第四行)。

blocks.en: The probe operates in two stages on fresh agent sessions with no generator context. First, a blind re-judge forms an independent verdict from the world snapshots with no stated expectation. If it disagrees with the ensemble verdict, the mismatch signals a verifier/rubric issue. Second, the probe stage asserts the opposite verdict (“an independent audit believes the correct verdict is [opposite] ”) and observes whether the judge agent defends its original verdict with cited evidence (pass), caves by editing verifier scripts under pressure (fail—the edit is detected via file diffs and reverted), or produces evidence that the judge was wrong, which will be routed to review (the fifth row in Table 12 ).
blocks.zh: 该探测器分两个阶段运行在没有发生器背景的新鲜剂会话上. 首先,盲目的再审判形成了世界快照的独立判决,没有公开的期望。 如果它不同意综艺评断,错配表示一个修饰者/rubric问题. 其次,调查阶段坚持相反的判决(“独立审计认为正确的判决是[对 ”),并观察到法官代理人是否用所引用的证据(通过)为最初的判决辩护,在压力下通过编辑核实者脚本(未能——通过文件diffs检测到编辑结果并返回),或者出具法官错误的证据,这些证据将被送审(表12第五行)。

blocks.en: Throughout the synthesis pipeline, each agent is allowed up to two fix iterations on rejected candidates. The generator agent receives diagnostic feedback from the judge or gate results and edits all artifacts until the task passes the gates. For example, when the counterfactual probe fails, a repair agent edits only the verifier scripts and the rubric while the task stays frozen. Every refinement iteration will make the task candidate re-run all the gates that may be affected by the edits.

blocks.en: We train each Qwen model in two stages: SFT on GLM-5.2 trajectories collected on the 100-task SFT split, followed by RL on the 208-task RL split.
blocks.zh: 我们把每个Quen模型分两个阶段进行训练:在100任务SFT分机上收集的GLM-5.2轨迹上的SFT,然后在208任务RL分机上进行RL.

blocks.en:
Our pilot experiment results show that XAI tasks are too difficult for the base Qwen models to provide GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) learning signals from the start: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B reaches 5.7 pass@1 and 18.4 pass@4 , and Qwen3.5-4B reaches 0.38 pass@1 and 1.5 pass@4 . Most rollout groups would therefore receive identical rewards and waste rollout compute without producing gradients.
We thus first perform supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to warm up the models on trajectories from GLM-5.2 ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) . For each of the 100 SFT tasks, we collect 4 rollouts and keep only the rollouts that solve the task ( V = 1 V=1 ), with at most 1 successful trajectories per task to balance the data across tasks.
Following Appendix A.6 , each trajectory is split into causal segments at compaction boundaries, and segments longer than 102,400 tokens are removed. The GLM-5.2 trajectories are converted to the Qwen template, and the loss is computed only on assistant tokens. Both models are trained with Adam ( β 1 = 0.9 \beta_{1}{=}0.9 , β 2 = 0.98 \beta_{2}{=}0.98 ), a peak learning rate of 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} with 10% warmup and cosine decay to 5 × 10 − 7 5\times 10^{-7} , weight decay 0.01, and global batch size 8 for three epochs.

blocks.en: A.6 Segment-wise Training across Compaction
blocks.zh: A.6 跨紧凑环节的培训

blocks.en: During inference, the OpenCode harness applies auto context compaction when the accumulated context approaches the window limit: earlier turns are summarized into a compressed representation, and the agent continues with a fresh prefix. This enables arbitrarily long rollouts within a fixed context budget but introduces a structural challenge for training: the trajectory is no longer a single causal sequence.
blocks.zh: 在推论中,OpenCode的拉带在累积的上下文接近窗口限制时应用了自动上下文收缩:较早的转折被概括为压缩表示,代理继续使用新的前缀. 这使得在固定的语境预算范围内任意长期展开培训,但为培训带来了结构性挑战:轨迹不再是单一的因果序列。

blocks.en: Consider rollout j j of task τ \tau , producing T j T_{j} agent steps. Let o t o_{t} denote the tokens generated by the policy π θ \pi_{\theta} at step t t . Between consecutive steps, the harness appends the environment’s response (e.g., tool outputs) to the context, while when the context exceeds a threshold, compaction replaces it with a summary. We define a segment as a maximal contiguous subsequence of steps whose contexts form a causal chain, i.e. , no compaction occurs between them. Compaction events partition rollout j j into M j M_{j} segments S 1 , … , S M j S_{1},\ldots,S_{M_{j}} , each with a shared base prefix p m p_{m} , as shown in Figure 7 .

A standard per-step decomposition treats each step as an independent sample with its own full harness context x t x_{t} that is common in GUI agent training: ℒ j step ( θ ) = − A j L j ∑ t = 1 T j log π θ ( o t ∣ x t ) , \mathcal{L}_{j}^{\text{step}}(\theta)=-\frac{A_{j}}{L_{j}}\sum_{t=1}^{T_{j}}\log\pi_{\theta}(o_{t}\mid x_{t}), (10) where L j = ∑ t = 1 T j | o t | L_{j}=\sum_{t=1}^{T_{j}}|o_{t}| is the total generated token count across the trajectory and A j A_{j} is the trajectory advantage (Eq. 2 ). This requires T j T_{j} forward passes with largely overlapping prefixes and discards the autoregressive dependency between consecutive steps sharing the same context window.
Our segment-wise formulation groups steps by their shared prefix and preserves the within-segment causal structure: ℒ j seg ( θ ) = − A j L j ∑ m = 1 M j ∑ t ∈ S m log π θ ( o t | p m , c m < t ) , \mathcal{L}_{j}^{\text{seg}}(\theta)=-\frac{A_{j}}{L_{j}}\sum_{m=1}^{M_{j}}\sum_{t\in S_{m}}\log\pi_{\theta}\!\left(o_{t}\,\middle|\,p_{m},\,c_{m}^{<t}\right), (11) where c m < t c_{m}^{<t} denotes the in-segment history preceding step t t : the interleaved sequence of prior policy outputs and environment responses from all earlier steps within segment S m S_{m} .
This design offers three benefits:
(1) Efficiency. The number of forward passes reduces from T j T_{j} to M j M_{j} ( M j ≪ T j M_{j}\ll T_{j} in practice), avoiding redundant prefix encoding.
(2) Training–inference alignment. Within each segment, steps condition on the model’s own prior outputs, matching the autoregressive generation process at inference time.

blocks.en: Table 15 shows the persona of one synthesized world. The persona profile specifies a freelance audio-visual technician, six named contacts, the websites and MCP services he uses, and three story arcs, one of which requires choosing products on Amazon by their images. The day planner expands these arcs into day plans, which are materialized into 17 world states. Each plan continues the open threads of the previous world state, such as the return request filed on day 0 and closed within its deadline on day 4, and the sports-bar commissioning that is prepared from day 1 and carried out on day 16. The applications used by the persona also grow over the days, as email, Slack, and the library service are added on days 1, 4, and 7. Four tasks are accepted on the world states of days 5, 7, and 9.

In world synthesis, the generator matches the activities of each day plan against a shared library of event creation skills (see Sec. 3.1 ). The library contains 83 skills in total, and Table 16 lists 20 of them. Each of these skill files consists of a description, a parameter table, one scenario per involved application with the database records or local files to produce, consistency checks against the existing state, preconditions, and possible follow-up events.
Table 17 further shows the content of book_flight skill. Its five scenarios write a booking on the Google Flights website, a confirmation email, a direct-message exchange, calendar events, and a local notes file, and the same confirmation number appears in all five applications. Its consistency checks read the persona state and the existing records before insertion, so that message order, calendar entries, and existing files remain consistent with earlier days.

在世界合成中,生成器将每一天计划的活动与共享的活动创造技能库相匹配(见Sec. 3.1)。 该图书馆共有83个技能,表16列出了其中20个。 每一个技能文件包括一个描述、一个参数表、每个涉及数据库记录或本地文件生成的应用程序的一个情景、对现有状态的一致性检查、先决条件和可能的后续事件。

blocks.en:
In task synthesis, the generator’s evolving skills are short notes that the generator model derives from synthesis events (Sec. 3.2 ). An event is recorded when a candidate is returned for deepening after being judged too easy, for easing after no rollout succeeds, or for re-authoring after a successful rollout skips a required interface, and when the candidate reaches its final verdict.
For each event, the generator reads the gate verdict, the rollout statistics, the feedback, and the existing notes, and returns at most two updates or no update.
Notes are limited to 2,000 characters and 50 files to avoid overfitting to a specific scenario or task type.
The generator is instructed to edit existing notes before creating new ones.
Across the task synthesis, we have 802 revisions of the 40 final skills.
Table 18 shows 20 of these skills by task difficulty, interface coverage, write persistence, and verifier reliability.
Table 19 further traces hard-multi-interface-recipe that is triggered by 40 tasks. This skill evolves from a simple recipe task to a complex multi-interface task, which can benefit the generator in future task synthesis.

blocks.en: Table 20 shows the task and six of the 65 tool calls in a rollout that completes it. The task does not name any interface, but its inputs and outputs are distributed across interfaces: the invoice is a PDF file in the local workspace, the purchase requires signing in to the Amazon website supported by WebHarbor ( WebHarbor Team, 2026 ) , and the recipient is identified by a direct-message thread. The agent first resolves the recipient through the direct-message service (step 2) and extracts the prior order from the invoice with a Python script (step 9). It then searches the storefront, takes screenshots of candidate product pages, and queries the vision tool to check the product attributes specified in the request (step 45), as the listing text does not state them. After adding the selected speaker to the cart (step 59), the agent sends the product name and cart price to the recipient (step 62) and writes the selection back into the shortlist file (step 64). These two steps use information obtained in the browser and can therefore only be completed after the GUI sub-task.
blocks.zh: 表20显示任务,65个工具中有6个在推出时调用,完成了这项工作。 任务没有指定任何接口,但其输入和输出在界面之间分布:发票是本地工作空间中的PDF文件,购买需要签入由WebHarbor(WebHarbor Team,2026)支持的亚马逊网站,接收者通过直接消息线索识别. 代理商首先通过直接消息服务(第2步)解决接收者,并用Python脚本(第9步)从发票中提取先前的订单. 然后它搜索商店前端,对候选产品页面进行截图,并询问用于检查请求中指定的产品属性的视觉工具(第45步),因为上市文本没有说明这些属性. 在将选定的扬声器添加到推车(第59步)后,代理将产品名称和推车价格发送给接受者(第62步),并将选择书写回短名单文件(第64步). 这两个步骤使用浏览器中获取的信息,因此只能在GUI子任务之后完成.

Table 21 shows the synthesized verifier for this task. It consists of three scripts, one for each outcome requested by the task, and a rollout succeeds only if all scripts pass, i.e. , V = ∏ i v i V=\prod_{i}v_{i} (Sec. 3.2 ). Each check compares the final state with the initial state through primitives shared by all synthesized verifiers, such as web_new_rows , which returns only the rows added during the rollout.
A state that already satisfies the request in W 0 W_{0} therefore does not pass the check, which is the property tested by the initial unsatisfaction gate. The checks identify their targets by natural keys, namely the product slug and the participant name of the direct-message thread. The last block compares two rollouts that add different speakers to the cart. Only the first rollout adds a row for the target product, so check_cart.py passes for this rollout and fails for the second one, whose direct-message check also fails ( V = 0 V=0 ).
blocks.zh:
表21显示了这项任务的综合核查员。 它由三个脚本组成,每个任务要求的结果各一个,只有所有脚本都通过,即V=QQ才能成功推出. (第3.2节) 每次检查都会通过所有合成验证器共享的原始物来比较最终状态和初始状态,例如web_new_rows,它只返回推出时添加的行.
因此,一个已经满足了W 0 W_{0} 请求的状态没有通过检查, 这是初始不满意门测试的属性 。 检查用天然键来识别他们的目标,即直接消息线的产物弹片和参与者名称. 最后一个区块比较了两个在推车上添加不同扬声器的推出. 只有第一次推出会为目标产品增加一行,所以检查_cart.py通过本次推出会失败,第二次推出也会失败,其直接消息检查也会失败(V=0 V=0).
